requirement: The library shall compare previous and current object states and generate audit events identifying creation, modification, and deletion of objects or elements. Each reported change shall include the element name, previous value, updated value, and fully qualified field identifier. Supported object inputs shall include UUIDs, nullable and non-null scalar fields, maps, lists, and nested objects.
Applications shall be able to configure the application identity, event source, event subtype, and additional metadata recorded in generated audit events.

Applications shall be able to enable inclusion filtering and specify which elements to audit. When filtering is enabled, emitted audit events shall contain only elements matching the configured inclusion list.
The library shall publish generated audit events as JSON payloads that downstream consumers can deserialize. The default publisher shall deliver these events to a configured Kafka topic.

The component shall be a Kotlin client library suitable for integration into Java 11/JVM 11 applications. Integrating applications shall be able to supply replaceable implementations for event publishing, logging, and audit-element filtering.
